import sys

def main():
    data = iter(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    S = next(data)
    T = next(data)

    adj = [bytearray(S + 1) for _ in range(S + 1)]

    for _ in range(T):
        x = next(data)
        y = next(data)
        adj[x][y] = 1
        adj[y][x] = 1

    P = next(data)
    ans = 0

    for _ in range(P):
        N = next(data)
        prev = next(data)
        ok = True

        for _ in range(N - 1):
            cur = next(data)
            if not adj[prev][cur]:
                ok = False
            prev = cur

        if ok:
            ans += 1

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
